title: Psalm 138
opening_line: Thee will I praise with all my heart,

source.note: Received text from the official Free Church digital edition and plain-text archive.

text.diplomatic: Thee will I praise with all my heart,
text.normalized: Thee will I praise with all my heart,
text.reading: Thee will I praise with all my heart,

text.diplomatic: I will sing praise to thee
text.normalized: I will sing praise to thee
text.reading: I will sing praise to thee

text.diplomatic: Before the gods: And worship will
text.normalized: Before the gods: And worship will
text.reading: Before the gods: And worship will

text.diplomatic: toward thy sanctuary.
text.normalized: Toward thy sanctuary.
text.reading: toward thy sanctuary.

text.diplomatic: I’ll praise thy name, ev’n for thy truth,
text.normalized: I’ll praise thy name, ev’n for thy truth,
text.reading: I’ll praise thy name, ev’n for thy truth,

text.diplomatic: and kindness of thy love;
text.normalized: And kindness of thy love;
text.reading: and kindness of thy love;

text.diplomatic: For thou thy word hast magnified
text.normalized: For thou thy word hast magnified
text.reading: For thou thy word hast magnified

text.diplomatic: all thy great name above.
text.normalized: All thy great name above.
text.reading: all thy great name above.

text.diplomatic: Thou didst me answer in the day
text.normalized: Thou didst me answer in the day
text.reading: Thou didst me answer in the day

text.diplomatic: when I to thee did cry;
text.normalized: When I to thee did cry;
text.reading: when I to thee did cry;

text.diplomatic: And thou my fainting soul with strength
text.normalized: And thou my fainting soul with strength
text.reading: And thou my fainting soul with strength

text.diplomatic: didst strengthen inwardly.
text.normalized: Didst strengthen inwardly.
text.reading: didst strengthen inwardly.

text.diplomatic: All kings upon the earth that are
text.normalized: All kings upon the earth that are
text.reading: All kings upon the earth that are

text.diplomatic: shall give thee praise, O LORD;
text.normalized: Shall give thee praise, O LORD;
text.reading: shall give thee praise, O LORD;

text.diplomatic: When as they from thy mouth shall hear
text.normalized: When as they from thy mouth shall hear
text.reading: When as they from thy mouth shall hear

text.diplomatic: thy true and faithful word.
text.normalized: Thy true and faithful word.
text.reading: thy true and faithful word.

text.diplomatic: Yea, in the righteous ways of GOD
text.normalized: Yea, in the righteous ways of GOD
text.reading: Yea, in the righteous ways of GOD

text.diplomatic: with gladness they shall sing:
text.normalized: With gladness they shall sing:
text.reading: with gladness they shall sing:

text.diplomatic: For great’s the glory of the LORD,
text.normalized: For great’s the glory of the LORD,
text.reading: For great’s the glory of the LORD,

text.diplomatic: who doth for ever reign.
text.normalized: Who doth for ever reign.
text.reading: who doth for ever reign.

text.diplomatic: Though GOD be high, yet he respects
text.normalized: Though GOD be high, yet he respects
text.reading: Though GOD be high, yet he respects

text.diplomatic: all those that lowly be;
text.normalized: All those that lowly be;
text.reading: all those that lowly be;

text.diplomatic: Whereas the proud and lofty ones
text.normalized: Whereas the proud and lofty ones
text.reading: Whereas the proud and lofty ones

text.diplomatic: afar off knoweth he.
text.normalized: Afar off knoweth he.
text.reading: afar off knoweth he.

text.diplomatic: Though I in midst of trouble walk,
text.normalized: Though I in midst of trouble walk,
text.reading: Though I in midst of trouble walk,

text.diplomatic: I life from thee shall have:
text.normalized: I life from thee shall have:
text.reading: I life from thee shall have:

text.diplomatic: ’Gainst my foes’ wrath thou’lt stretch thine hand;
text.normalized: ’Gainst my foes’ wrath thou’lt stretch thine hand;
text.reading: ’Gainst my foes’ wrath thou’lt stretch thine hand;

text.diplomatic: thy right hand shall me save.
text.normalized: Thy right hand shall me save.
text.reading: thy right hand shall me save.

text.diplomatic: Surely that which concerneth me
text.normalized: Surely that which concerneth me
text.reading: Surely that which concerneth me

text.diplomatic: the LORD will perfect make:
text.normalized: The LORD will perfect make:
text.reading: the LORD will perfect make:

text.diplomatic: LORD, still thy mercy lasts; do not
text.normalized: LORD, still thy mercy lasts; do not
text.reading: LORD, still thy mercy lasts; do not

text.diplomatic: thine own hands’ works forsake.
